verses.english: The Chapter on the Brahmin’s Offering of the Teaching
This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Jānatohaṁ, bhikkhave, passato āsavānaṁ khayaṁ vadāmi, no ajānato no apassato.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I say that the ending of defilements is for one who knows and sees, not for one who does not know or see.

verses.pali: Kiñca, bhikkhave, jānato, kiṁ passato āsavānaṁ khayo hoti?
verses.english: For one who knows and sees what?

verses.pali: Idaṁ dukkhanti, bhikkhave, jānato passato āsavānaṁ khayo hoti. Ayaṁ dukkhasamudayoti, bhikkhave, jānato passato āsavānaṁ khayo hoti. Ayaṁ dukkhanirodhoti, bhikkhave, jānato passato āsavānaṁ khayo hoti. Ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti, bhikkhave, jānato passato āsavānaṁ khayo hoti.
verses.english: The ending of defilements is for one who knows and sees suffering, its origin, its cessation, and the path.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, jānato evaṁ passato āsavānaṁ khayo hotī”ti.
verses.english: The ending of the defilements is for one who knows and sees this.”
enlightenment follows in the same lifetime.
Then to one freed through enlightenment
with the ending of the fetters.
or by fools who don’t understand

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
